name: The laptop layout's reading keys in a text area (old-pc runs the laptop layout): Tab twice into Body, CapsLock+O (Say Next Line: the field's Down), CapsLock+I (Say Line), CapsLock+U (Say Prior Line: Up), CapsLock+L (Say Next Word: Ctrl+Right). Okur presses the field's own key for each while CapsLock is down (f31824ee, 51547c3b); on Linux that key waits for the letter's release. Research on Linux first, then a JAWS recording
